verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so in-product AI insights on user data is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence does not show this capability. The docs cover built-in visitor tracking (page views, traffic sources, trends) without any AI-generated analysis. They also describe a query_database MCP tool, but that is a building block used by an external AI client such as Claude or ChatGPT, not an insights or suggestions feature inside Floot. Neither counts as the product delivering AI-generated insights from data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
